title: The Trial of Champions
_how_to_add_a_passage: Add an entry under "passages" keyed by the book's passage number: a "scene" (id from "scenes"), "text", optional "tier" (1 to 4, the difficulty of the background cues), and "choices": [{"label", "to": <passage number>, "book": <the book's wording of the link>, "phrase": <id from "phrases"> or null, "consequence": <text shown on a pass>, "default": true on exactly ONE choice}]. The default is what happens if the player has not chosen within four bars. Mark an unfinished end with "endpoint": true. The map of the whole quest is content/trial/quest_map.json: use the edges it lists. Then run: godot --headless --path . -s tools/trial/validate.gd. See docs/TRIAL_OPENING.md.

provenance.links: DuelMasterBattle DD/Deathtrap_Dungeon_Verified_Backbone.json (status verified_macrograph_not_full_400_node_adjacency), passages 1, 270, 66, 119 with their edges exactly as verified; 56 and 293 are prototype endpoints. Cross-checked with docs/TRIAL_CANON_STATUS.md (rows Crystal Entrance, Footprint Fork, Footprint Galleries; 'the east loop reconnects 119, 56': implemented legacy).

giant_fly.name: Giant Fly
giant_fly.intro: Something huge buzzes in the eastern dark. It smells of Water.
giant_fly.on_win: The Giant Fly spins out of the air and drops, buzzing, into the dark. The way east is open.
giant_fly.on_fail: The Giant Fly lunges and stings. You stagger back, ready to try again.
giant_fly.bestiary: legacy_bestiary.json giant_fly: 'A horsefly the size of a hound. It lunges first and thinks second, but it does think.' A loser may escape wounded.

1.title: The Crystal Entrance
1.text: Crystal veins hum faintly in the walls; the light has no source. At a stone table stand six boxes. Five are already open: the other contestants have helped themselves. The sixth bears your name.
1.text_source: legacy (dd_crystal, dd_table) and the verified beat

choices.label: Open the box with your name
choices.consequence: The seal breaks cleanly under your fingers.

choices.label: Continue north
choices.consequence: You leave the boxes behind and follow the crystal light north.

270.title: The Named Box
270.text: Inside: two gold pieces and a note in a sharp hand. SUKUMVIT: 'The Trial wants useful things, not just strong arms. Carry what matters.' Several items will be needed before this is done.

choices.label: Pocket the gold and go on
choices.consequence: Two gold pieces heavier, and warned, you press on.

66.title: The Footprint Fork
66.text: A white arrow, painted fresh, points WEST. Below it, in charcoal: 'don't'. Wet footprints, several sets, head west; one smaller set goes east.
66.text_source: legacy (dd_arrow, dd_prints_west, dd_prints_east) and the verified beat

choices.label: Follow the arrow west
choices.consequence: You trust the paint, and the footprints, and walk west.

choices.label: Follow the single set east
choices.consequence: The small prints are the odd ones out. You follow them east.

119.title: The Eastern Branch
119.text: A cold draught comes from the east, and a single small footprint is pressed into the wet. An open box with a broken seal: someone got here first. Ahead, a soft grey curtain blocks the way, and something behind it hums.
119.text_source: legacy (dd_east_draught, dd_empty_box) and the verified beat

choices.label: Push through the curtain, east
choices.consequence: The curtain tears away, and the way east is open.

choices.label: Go back and take the arrow west
choices.consequence: You turn back to the fork and take the painted way after all.

56.title: The Way Opens
56.text: The soft obstruction parts and light spills through. This is as far as the opening goes for now: passage 56 is a prototype endpoint, reached from the named box and from the eastern branch.

293.title: Three Sets of Footprints
293.text: The trail divides: two sets of prints go west, one goes north. This is as far as the opening goes for now: passage 293 is a prototype endpoint (the book continues west to 137 and north to 382).
